mentions.name: jcpractices math
mentions.description: A YouTube livestream channel sharing the creator's near-daily math study sessions, thinking out loud with an iPad on screen, with an emphasis on algebra and number theory.
mentions.problem: The creator, retraining to become a schoolteacher as a second career, uses the livestream to deliberately practice teaching and refresh math skills.
